# Hi, I'm Armin!

### Passionate Software Developer & Aviation Nerd

I work as a Senior Software Architect and Engineer, specializing in Java, Spring Boot, Angular and Node.js.

My passions are anything connected to aviation, the stock market and software engineering. The latter two are combined
in my project [TraQuity](https://github.com/aslopek/traquity), which I also use personally to track my investments.

In this project, I experiment on different coding problems such as
- good API design
- integrating local LLMs into an app
- building an app using electron
- cryptography (confidentiality and integrity)
- and many more
